open_points.subject: M26 EffectAttempt authority selection
open_points.text: "authority": the approval or the grant it used, or for a `draft-write` send the flow activation of the run's version
open_points.question: If both authorities are simultaneously available for the same operation send (an applicable unused approval and an active standing grant), which one must the kernel use and record, and what must happen to the other authority's state?
options: Always prefer the explicit approval when it matches the request; mark it `used`
Always prefer the standing grant when active; keep approval unused
Define a fixed precedence by recency (latest decision wins)
open_points.default_guess: Prefer a matching explicit approval, because it is run-specific and already requested for that exact send.

open_points.subject: K-04 run pinning vs M10 manifest reads
open_points.text: K-04: "A run pins what it uses." / M10: "Read ... every time the operation is invoked"
open_points.question: For operation nodes, does a run pin manifest-derived invocation facts (base URL, required headers, instance selection, record digest check context) at run start, or are they re-read at each attempt/resume?
options: Pin operation invocation context at run start
Re-read manifest/installation context at each operation attempt
Pin some fields (e.g., binding) but re-read instance/address fields
open_points.default_guess: Re-read at each attempt, since M10 explicitly says every invocation and owner decision 18 expects request changes to trigger re-approval.

open_points.subject: M28 installation change visibility
open_points.text: "the configuration is read at start; the token list is read again whenever it has changed"
open_points.question: Are non-token installation fields (manifest revision/location, service instance selection, credentials refs, MCP listen address) immutable for process lifetime, or can they be reloaded without restart?
options: Only tokens are hot-reloaded; all other fields require restart
open_points.default_guess: Only token list is reloaded dynamically; other installation fields apply on restart.

open_points.subject: M26 EffectAttempt scope by effect class
open_points.text: "The record written before an effect is sent" and `authority` includes approval/grant/flow activation for `draft-write`
open_points.question: Must EffectAttempt be created for `read` operation nodes, or only for non-read effect classes (`draft-write`, `state-transition`, `external-effect`, `destructive`)?
options: Create EffectAttempt for all operation invocations including `read`
Create EffectAttempt only for non-read effect classes
Create EffectAttempt only for classes requiring owner approval
open_points.default_guess: Create EffectAttempt only for non-read effect classes, since it exists to track uncertain side effects.
